title: DroidKit registry item
description: Metadata for one installable item. Lives as registry.json beside the Kotlin files.

name.description: Kebab-case id used by the CLI: droidkit add <name>

description.description: One sentence. When to use it.

avoidWhen.description: One sentence. When not to use it.

kind.description: source and preview copy by default; test copies with --with-tests

dependencies.description: Maven coordinates the CLI may add, e.g. io.coil-kt.coil3:coil-compose:3.0.0

registryDependencies.description: Other items that must be installed first

platform.description: android uses Android-only APIs; common is Compose Multiplatform-compatible

composeBom.description: Minimum androidx.compose:compose-bom version this item compiles against

themeVersion.description: Theme contract version this item requires

experimentalApis.description: Opt-in annotations the copied code carries, e.g. androidx.compose.material3.ExperimentalMaterial3Api

adaptive.description: Changes layout across window size classes

aiHints.description: Short rules an agent should follow when composing this item

items.description: Recipe only: the items this recipe installs
